clips.title: The story
paras: Harvesting the Harvesters is a local quest in Westfall where players assist Ozwin Ironsprocket, a visiting gnome tinkerer trapped inside a stable at Saldean's Farm. After underestimating the ferocity of the region's haywire harvest golems, Ozwin requires salvaged mechanical components to construct an escape contraption.

The agricultural flatlands of Westfall have descended into chaos, overrun not only by outlaws but by rampaging mechanical harvesters. Word of these haywire automatons reached the technological workshops of Ironforge, inspiring the gnomish engineer Ozwin Ironsprocket to journey south. Confident in his technical acumen, Ozwin believed he could diagnose and recalibrate the wayward farm machinery to restore peace to the region's beleaguered farmlands.

Upon arriving in the fields surrounding Saldean's Farm, Ozwin quickly discovered that the harvest golems were far more volatile and violent than theoretical schematics suggested. The razor-sharp blades and erratic swings of the machines sent the gnome fleeing for his life into a nearby stable. Trapped and unable to venture out into the fields, Ozwin relies on daring adventurers to salvage salvageable isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the mechanical terror so he can assemble a device to safely escape.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Oh no... I'm in for it now!

I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable!
If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: It's a mess out there, friend! Did you collect the parts I need?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thanks a bunch! I'll get to work on an escape plan. In the meantime, take this!
